fr_html: On regrette infiniment que l'organisation de la future Cour de Justice Internationale sera probablement telle que seuls des Etats pourront être parties au procès.
en_html: It is deeply regretted that the organisation of the new Court of International Justice will probably be such that States only may appear before it.
